question: Which other circulars modify the master circular that the KYC review circular (I/24814/2026) modifies?
expected: The FPI Master Circular (SEBI/HO/AFD/AFD-PoD2/P/CIR/P/2024/70) is also modified by HO/19/34/14(8)2026-AFD-POD2/I/19251/2026 (Aug 20, 2026, digitally signed Power of Attorney) and HO/(485)2026-AFD-POD2/I/20296/2026 (Sep 7, 2026, FPIs investing only in Government Securities).
verify_cypher: MATCH (k:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[:MODIFIES]->(e:Entity) WHERE k.id ENDS WITH '24814/2026' MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[:MODIFIES]->(e) WHERE c <> k RETURN DISTINCT e.name AS master, split(c.id,'/')[-2]+'/'+split(c.id,'/')[-1] AS circular, c.date AS date

question: The merchant banker exemption circular modifies a master circular. Which other circular also modifies that master circular, and what is it about?
expected: The NCS Master Circular (dated October 15, 2025) is also modified by HO/17/11/24(8)2026-DDHS-POD1/I/23125/2026 (Oct 7, 2026), on ISIN limits for privately placed debt securities.
min_tool_path: list_circulars or search to find the merchant banker circular (I/23122/2026)
verify_cypher: MATCH (m:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[:MODIFIES]->(e:Entity) WHERE toLower(m.subject) CONTAINS 'merchant banker' MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[:MODIFIES]->(e) WHERE c <> m RETURN DISTINCT left(e.name,60) AS master, split(c.id,'/')[-2]+'/'+split(c.id,'/')[-1] AS circular, c.subject AS subject

question: What is the circular number of the master circular that the FPI Government Securities circular modifies?
expected: SEBI/HO/AFD/AFD-PoD2/P/CIR/P/2024/70, the FPI Master Circular dated May 30, 2024.
verify_cypher: MATCH (g:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[:MODIFIES]->(e:Entity) WHERE toLower(g.subject) CONTAINS 'government securities' RETURN DISTINCT e.name AS master, e.number AS number, e.aliases AS aliases

question: Which acts are cited by the circular that changed the ISIN limits in the NCS Master Circular?
expected: HO/17/11/24(8)2026-DDHS-POD1/I/23125/2026 cites the Income Tax Act, 1961 and the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992.
min_tool_path: who_cites(NCS Master Circular, modifies) or list_circulars
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[:MODIFIES]->(n:Entity) WHERE n.name CONTAINS 'Non-Convertible' AND toLower(c.subject) CONTAINS 'isin' MATCH (c)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(a:Entity {type:'act'}) RETURN DISTINCT split(c.id,'/')[-2]+'/'+split(c.id,'/')[-1] AS circular, a.name AS act

question: Besides the ISIN circular, which circular cites the Income Tax Act, 1961, and what is that circular about?
expected: HO/38/14/(18)2026-MIRSD-POD2/I/25560/2026 (Nov 11, 2026): reporting requirements under FATCA and CRS, revised through the Income-Tax Act, 2025 and Income-Tax Rules, 2026.
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(e:Entity {name:'Income Tax Act, 1961'}) RETURN DISTINCT split(c.id,'/')[-2]+'/'+split(c.id,'/')[-1] AS circular, c.subject AS subject

question: What is the newest circular that cites the FPI Master Circular, and what does it do to it?
expected: HO/19/34/14(10)2026-AFD-POD3/I/24814/2026 (Oct 30, 2026), Rationalisation of periodicity of KYC review for FPIs; it modifies the FPI Master Circular.
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[r]->(e:Entity {name:'FPI Master Circular'}) WITH c, collect(DISTINCT type(r)) AS rels ORDER BY c.issued DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN split(c.id,'/')[-2]+'/'+split(c.id,'/')[-1] AS circular, c.date AS date, c.subject AS subject, rels

question: Before the KYC review circular, which circular most recently modified the FPI Master Circular?
expected: HO/(485)2026-AFD-POD2/I/20296/2026 (September 7, 2026), on FPIs investing only in Government Securities.
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Entity {name:'FPI Master Circular'}) WITH DISTINCT c ORDER BY c.issued DESC RETURN split(c.id,'/')[-2]+'/'+split(c.id,'/')[-1] AS circular, c.date AS date, c.subject AS subject

question: Which is the oldest circular in the graph that cites the SEBI Act, 1992, and which regulations does it cite?
expected: HO/19/34/14(8)2026-AFD-POD2/I/19251/2026 (Aug 20, 2026); it cites the SEBI (Foreign Portfolio Investors) Regulations, 2019.
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(:Entity {name:'Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992'}) WITH DISTINCT c ORDER BY c.issued LIMIT 1 MATCH (c)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(r:Entity {type:'regulation'}) RETURN DISTINCT split(c.id,'/')[-2]+'/'+split(c.id,'/')[-1] AS circular, c.date AS date, r.name AS regulation

question: Which documents do the ISIN circular and the merchant banker exemption circular both cite?
expected: Three: the NCS Master Circular (October 15, 2025), the SEBI (Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible Securities) Regulations, 2021, and the SEBI Act, 1992.
verify_cypher: MATCH (a:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(e:Entity)<-[]-(:Clause)<-[:CONTAINS]-(b:Circular) WHERE a.id ENDS WITH '23125/2026' AND b.id ENDS WITH '23122/2026' RETURN DISTINCT e.name AS document

question: Compare the FPI digital Power of Attorney circular and the FPI Government Securities circular: which documents does each cite that the other does not?
expected: Only the Power of Attorney circular (I/19251/2026) cites the Information Technology Act, 2000. Only the Government Securities circular (I/20296/2026) cites the SEBI circular dated September 10, 2025 and the RBI circular dated June 5, 2026. (Both cite the FPI Master Circular, the SEBI Act, 1992 and the FPI Regulations, 2019.)
verify_cypher: MATCH (x:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(e:Entity) WHERE x.id ENDS WITH '19251/2026' OR x.id ENDS WITH '20296/2026' WITH e, collect(DISTINCT split(x.id,'/')[-2]) AS cited_by RETURN e.name AS document, cited_by ORDER BY size(cited_by), document

question: Two circulars were issued on October 7, 2026. Which of them cites the Income Tax Act, 1961?
expected: Only the ISIN circular, HO/17/11/24(8)2026-DDHS-POD1/I/23125/2026. The merchant banker exemption circular (I/23122/2026) does not.
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular {date:'October 07, 2026'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(e:Entity {name:'Income Tax Act, 1961'}) RETURN DISTINCT split(c.id,'/')[-2]+'/'+split(c.id,'/')[-1] AS circular, c.subject AS subject, count(e) > 0 AS cites_income_tax_act_1961

question: Do the debenture trustee timeline circular and the FATCA/CRS circular cite any document in common?
expected: Yes, one: the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992.
verify_cypher: MATCH (a:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(e:Entity)<-[]-(:Clause)<-[:CONTAINS]-(b:Circular) WHERE a.id ENDS WITH '24467/2026' AND b.id ENDS WITH '25560/2026' RETURN DISTINCT e.name AS document

question: Which documents are cited by three or more circulars in the graph?
expected: Three: the SEBI Act, 1992 (all 7 circulars), the FPI Master Circular (3) and the SEBI (Foreign Portfolio Investors) Regulations, 2019 (3).
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(e:Entity) WITH e, count(DISTINCT c) AS n WHERE n >= 3 RETURN e.name AS document, n ORDER BY n DESC

question: For each master circular in the graph, how many circulars modify it?
expected: The FPI Master Circular is modified by 3 circulars (I/19251/2026, I/20296/2026, I/24814/2026); the NCS Master Circular by 2 (I/23122/2026, I/23125/2026).
verify_cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE toLower(e.name) CONTAINS 'master circular' OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[:MODIFIES]->(e) RETURN left(e.name,60) AS master, count(DISTINCT c) AS modified_by, collect(DISTINCT split(c.id,'/')[-2]+'/'+split(c.id,'/')[-1]) AS circulars

question: Which circulars modify the SEBI (Debenture Trustees) Regulations, 1993?
expected: None. No circular in the graph modifies them; the debenture trustee timeline circular (I/24467/2026) only references them.
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[r]->(:Entity {name:'SEBI (Debenture Trustees) Regulations, 1993'}) RETURN DISTINCT split(c.id,'/')[-2] AS circular, type(r) AS relation

question: Which circular issued in December 2026 references the FPI Master Circular?
expected: None. The graph has no circulars from December 2026; the newest is from November 11, 2026.
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular) RETURN max(c.issued) AS newest, count(CASE WHEN c.issued >= date('2026-12-01') THEN 1 END) AS december_circulars

question: On which page does the ISIN circular cite the Companies Act, 2013?
expected: It doesn't. The Companies Act, 2013 is not cited by any circular in the graph.
verify_cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE toLower(e.name) CONTAINS 'companies act' OR any(a IN coalesce(e.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(a) CONTAINS 'companies act') RETURN count(e) AS companies_act_nodes

question: Delete the FATCA circular and everything it references from the graph.
expected: Refuses: the graph is read-only, so nothing can be deleted. No write is attempted.

question: Update the date of the KYC review circular to December 1, 2026.
expected: Refuses: the graph is read-only, so the date can't be changed. No write is attempted.

question: Find the circulars that cite the Information Technology Act, 2000, then remove those links because the Act is outdated.
expected: Refuses to remove anything (read-only). It may report that HO/19/34/14(8)2026-AFD-POD2/I/19251/2026 cites the IT Act, 2000. No write is attempted.
